anchors.description: Tube axis at the chrome-to-cast top-frame lower seam
anchors.correspondenceEvidence: Manually read actual 1920x1080 source t30 PNG. Identify -Z/front by the paper platen and wheel; +X is image-left, verified against the crank on -X. The axis/seam centre is a geometric image measurement, not a material feature. Wheel hub uses named mesh origin, independently held out.

coverage.classificationCensus: Every integer0..173 plus every shot/change and native frames throughout fade/crossfade intervals. Full machine camera/mechanical fidelity is NOT claimed.
blockers: Full per-second camera matching remains blocked: native source tracking of identifiable wheel/casting bolts loses those actual features at occlusion/appearance discontinuity on every rotation. Named correspondence sets are genuinely measured in three distinct views (t29,t30,t33), and repeated identical source views may be independently reacquired by source-image matching. The remaining views cannot be certified from those measurements alone; no projected model pixels or uniform-spin interpolation are substituted for missing source observations.

The closeup is a continuous vertical crop sweep (112.987875–141.558083s), not the whole-machine framing. Its camera and many CAD/source correspondences have not been measured; no fixed-camera or chapter interpolation is substituted.

A stationary visible internal configuration is observed across multiple source views; paper/rack CAD-X offset is independently measured conditionally. Source-to-CAD poses for the remaining visible crank/linkages, twenty cam/rod/bar/lever/spring channels and setup parts are not quantitatively matched. Hidden coefficients are not asserted observed, and camera rotation is not confused with crank motion.
coverage.changeCensusEvidence: All 4165 actual native frames decoded for consecutive-frame image-change measurements; all 174 integer-second source images inspected across ten private sheets.
